title: EventWeaver scaling thesis and independent commercial challenge
overall_decision: Billion-plus criterion NOT ESTABLISHED for the selected offering. Do not expand the frozen supported-library policy. Preserve the verified instrument construction and investigate a bounded OEM-backed redesign only if new evidence changes the decision.

metric.unit: incremental annual net productive value created
metric.definition: Value over the strongest feasible conventional/current-AI alternative, net of incremental integration, operating, maintenance and coordination costs; avoid counting the same experiment, instrument or benefit twice.
metric.distinctions: Not annual revenue, profit, valuation or broad sector revenue. Current study does not supply a validated path to this target.

primary_sources.publisher: SPIE, author-issued press release hosted by A3
primary_sources.interpretation: A broad photonics contact-discovery pool and broad industry scale. Neither quantity measures eligible temporal-event instrument OEMs or demand for design packs. Do not count exhibitors as independent buyers or combine them with another overlapping directory.

Sector definition spans measurement systems, spectrometers, sensors and other instruments, including products outside EventWeaver. Company count is broader than SPIE core-component producer definitions. No eligible installed-base count or willingness to pay is supplied.

primary_sources.published: undated current home page; directory March 2025
primary_sources.access: Indexed official page retrieved; direct page timed out and full directory exceeded retrieval size limit
primary_sources.interpretation: Membership includes suppliers, service firms and other organizations; it is a prospecting directory, not a count of qualified scientific-instrument OEM buyers. Not added to SPIE counts.

excluded_or_unconfirmed_current_count.status: Found only in trade coverage of SPIE2026 during bounded search; original2026 report could not be accessed. Do not use as a primary-verified adoption denominator.

bottom_up_identity: Annual net productive value = active accepted deployments × attributable annual net benefit per deployment. First prove eligible organizations × adoption × qualified deployments/organization, then measure benefit against outside alternatives.
unsupported_quantities: adoption of an external design-only pack
repeat designs per buyer per year
field integration time and timing qualification cost
retention and renewal over multiple years

threshold_scenarios.label: small illustrative niche
threshold_scenarios.status: Unverified arithmetic illustration, not a forecast; eligibility, adoption and repeat demand all unsupported

threshold_scenarios.label: billion productive-value hurdle
threshold_scenarios.status: Threshold identity only; no observed deployment count or net value, and physical integration remains unvalidated

threshold_scenarios.label: billion revenue hurdle at frozen offer
threshold_scenarios.status: Arithmetic hurdle only; current bounded service market and staffing evidence do not justify it

frozen_policy_capacity_bound.status: Derived ceiling from frozen capacity assumptions, before failures, renewals, vacations, acquisition limits and procurement friction; not observed throughput

independent_economic_critique.issue: Demand and buyer value remain assumptions
independent_economic_critique.evidence: 180 prospects, 18% inquiry, 62% qualified, median gross value USD6500 and competitor quotes USD1500–3300 are modeled inputs. There is no observed list of 180 eligible prospects or verified buying process.
independent_economic_critique.consequence: A source-backed large industry does not validate this funnel or the modeled price.

independent_economic_critique.evidence: Independent current-AI-assisted conventional delivery passes the same technical tests; free-source and same-artifact alternatives are available.
independent_economic_critique.consequence: Reliability utilities 0.94/0.96/0.91 and assumed internal hours need buyer-specific validation. The product must sell accountable integration or an otherwise unavailable accepted outcome.

independent_economic_critique.issue: Selected policy is least loss within a bounded grid
independent_economic_critique.evidence: Three arrangements and five posted prices were considered; no-launch has zero incremental payoff and dominates every development launch policy.
independent_economic_critique.consequence: Confirmation justifies not expanding this selected policy under the assumptions. It does not prove every instrument business, every price or every contractual arrangement is uneconomic.

independent_economic_critique.issue: Competition is a stylized response model
independent_economic_critique.evidence: Competitor price factors, response day, supplier rate draws and reservation rate are exogenous. Buyers choose specified outside utilities and negotiate inside an imposed band.
independent_economic_critique.consequence: Do not call the outcome a uniquely identified equilibrium or an empirically calibrated game. Endogenous entry, reputation and strategic scope differentiation remain unmodeled.

independent_economic_critique.issue: Capacity and capital are not automatically scalable
independent_economic_critique.evidence: 18 weekly delivery hours, 6 sales/support hours, 8 reserved support hours/order and fixed capital commitments constrain admissions. Committed budget is conservative and is not released when some potential orders fail to finalize.
independent_economic_critique.consequence: Higher prospect volume can increase losses; it is not evidence of scalable profitable demand. The model is intentionally admission-conservative, not an optimized staffing model.

independent_economic_critique.issue: Successor option is already charged once
independent_economic_critique.evidence: USD4100 is in initial project startup costs; successor protocol separately labels the same extension/retention option.
independent_economic_critique.consequence: Treat it as campaign research financed by initial capital; do not add it again or present it as financed by earned surplus.

independent_economic_critique.evidence: 1024 seeds/scenario use imposed distributions, common shocks and behavioral probabilities.
independent_economic_critique.consequence: A simulated loss probability of one is not a measured real-world probability of one. No unconditional scenario mixture is specified.

bounded_evidence_gates.work: Classify 30 named prospective OEM/platforms from public primary documentation against programmable event input, an unsupported temporal task, access rights and likely acceptance owner.
bounded_evidence_gates.information: Eligible fraction and integration mismatch, rather than general industry size.
bounded_evidence_gates.continue_rule: Only proceed to permissioned interviews if at least five concrete relevant platforms survive document-level disqualification. Threshold is a management stopping rule, not a statistical conclusion.
bounded_evidence_gates.stop_rule: No named eligible platform or no task beyond incumbent functions.

bounded_evidence_gates.gate: Buyer evidence, after separate outreach authorization
bounded_evidence_gates.authorization: Not authorized or executed in this campaign
bounded_evidence_gates.budget_basis: 12 staff hours at USD135/hour; no payment/outreach now
bounded_evidence_gates.work: Conduct bounded interviews with budget owners about a recent actual task, engineering time, outside options, acceptance of a design-only deliverable and procurement requirements. Request evidence rather than hypothetical enthusiasm.
bounded_evidence_gates.information: Whether the offered deliverable can be accepted and why a buyer would pay despite free/current-AI alternatives.
bounded_evidence_gates.continue_rule: At least three documented qualified needs with a stated acceptance authority and a credible route to a paid, capped trial.
bounded_evidence_gates.stop_rule: Interviewed buyers require calibrated physical delivery or cannot identify a payable incremental benefit.

bounded_evidence_gates.authorization: Separate contract and financial authorization required; not executed
bounded_evidence_gates.budget_basis: Planning ceiling only, subject to real quote and buyer-provided hardware; not a forecast of actual integration cost
bounded_evidence_gates.work: Measure actual engineering, verification, integration, correction and support hours against the strongest same-information current-AI alternative; preserve acceptance and final collection outcomes.
bounded_evidence_gates.information: Actual unit cost, integration acceptance, buyer benefit and payment behavior.
bounded_evidence_gates.continue_rule: Acceptable functional/physical scope and positive complete-cost unit contribution under an evidenced price, followed by a small repeat batch before fixed expansion.
bounded_evidence_gates.stop_rule: Cost or unsupported scope eliminates buyer/provider surplus; no use of imagined future billion-scale payoff to override the stop.

information_value: No monetary expected value of information is claimed because probabilities linking these observations to a profitable redesign are unmeasured. Gates are ranked by how directly they resolve the current binding uncertainty per capped cost; default remains no expansion. More synthetic technical passes would not resolve willingness to pay.
source_read_scope: Read-only inspection of frozen business assumptions, policy, source and confirmation results; no simulator/policy edits and no additional technical test campaigns.
